description: Critical failure: AI documented a 'fix' for date/metrics extraction in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.md and pushed to remote without verifying it worked on the client. Root cause was that the async Gemini API call pattern failed silently, rendering the python regex fix useless. Post-mortem: NEVER document a fix as a system truth until it is VERIFIED working on the actual application flow.

event: AI Self-Correction: CJK Regex & Quota Exhaustion
description: Resolved elusive date ingestion bug. Root causes: 1) Python regex '\b' fails on CJK text (e.g. '2/1日記'), causing fallback to current date. Replaced with '(?<!\d)'/'(?!\d)'. 2) AI outputs are non-deterministic; LLM frequently omitted brackets in Markdown headers ('# 2026-02-24' vs '# [2026-02-24]'), breaking extraction. Regex rules must be ultra-permissive when parsing LLM outputs. 3) Encountered gemini-2.5-flash-lite 429 rate limit (20 req/day). Post-mortem: Always anticipate silent LLM formatting deviations and strict vendor quotas.
impact: High - Ingestion pipeline is now resilient to Chinese character boundaries and sloppy AI formatting.
